New messages are forwarded as they arrive; this background check only re-sends messages that got stuck when the app was killed mid-send. It never scans your inbox. Shorter = faster recovery, longer = fewer device wakes. Off disables the check (a message stuck mid-send would stay stuck).

Wake the device with an exact alarm instead of the system\'s deferred scheduler, which can be delayed by aggressive OEM battery optimization. For best results, allow unrestricted battery usage and grant the Alarms & reminders permission (Android 12+). The deferred scheduler remains active as a backup.

Uses the network\'s received time (PDU timestamp) to prevent message re-deliveries (common while roaming). Recommended only if you are experiencing re-deliveries. If you turn this on, be sure to enable duplicate protection as well (Aggressive recommended), or device imports will result in duplicate messages.
Filters out identical messages from the same sender received within a chosen time window. When off, only exact timestamp matches are filtered out.
